sources.title: VarshiniE25/medical-prescription-ocr: MedScript AI - GitHub
sources.snippet: MedScript AI is a locally-running, AI-powered system for extracting and structuring information from medical prescriptions. It combines: EasyOCR for robust text extraction from prescription images OpenCV for image preprocessing (denoising, deskewing, contrast enhancement) Ollama + Llama3 with regex-based fallback parsing for robust structured extraction Streamlit for a professional, healthcare ...
